_README: The pairs the wizard offers. Edit this file to add one - it is
DATA, so a new instrument does not need a code change or a new
SYMBOLS MUST BE SPELLED EXACTLY AS YOUR BROKER SPELLS THEM.
Brokers write gold as XAUUSD, XAUUSD.f, XAUUSD_ or GOLD, and the
engine cannot trade a name the terminal does not have. Check the
spelling in MetaTrader 5's Market Watch, or with the Find symbols
button on the Exchanges page, and set it here ONCE.
{contract} is the month-and-year code the trader types at setup
(Z6, 1226, Z2026 - again, whatever your broker uses). Put it in
either leg, both, or neither. A leg with no {contract} needs no
pair_type decides whether the spread has a fair value:
SPOT_FUTURE    spot against its own future - a basis
FUTURE_FUTURE  two contract months of one instrument - a spread
RELATED        two different instruments - NO fair value
Getting this wrong is not cosmetic: a basis priced as RELATED
loses its fair value, and two different instruments priced as a
basis are given one they do not have.
